## Observation

The store write path bounds `git add`, `git commit`, `git rm`, `checkout` and `reset` at 30 s (`event_commit_git._GIT_TIMEOUT = 30`, applied by `_run_git`). That bound was set to match the push bound (bug c2ba; `tests/unit/test_store_write_git_timeout_c2ba.py` pins `event_append._GIT_TIMEOUT == push._GIT_TIMEOUT`).

On 2026-10-27 at ~18:40 PDT a local `rebar edit` on the main checkout's tracker failed with `git commit failed while holding lock: git timed out after 30s` (recorded on bug `affordable-omphacite-sunfish`). The same tracker measured 213,713 index entries; with its stat cache invalidated, every index-refreshing git command cost ~49 s (`git status --porcelain`), so a commit that refreshes the index cannot finish inside 30 s there.

The report itself is accurate: the error text names the timeout. The question this ticket raises is the bound, not the message.

## Why it matters

`git commit -- <paths>` and `git add` refresh the index, so their cost grows with the number of index entries, not with the network. The sync path had the same shape (bug `painted-epidermal-shelduck`), and its fix moved local sync operations to gitutil's existing 120 s `_LOCAL_GIT_TIMEOUT`, keeping 30 s for `fetch`. `gitutil.run_git_write` already uses that 120 s local bound. The event write path is the remaining store path that bounds local index work at the network bound, and a timed-out write is a lost write that the user has to redo.

## Open design question (needs an owner decision)

c2ba chose 30 s deliberately: the write path holds the store write lock, and a short bound releases it quickly after a stalled volume. Raising it trades faster lock release for writes that succeed on large or stat-dirty stores. The prior decision record for c2ba should be read before changing it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The c2ba decision record is read and the trade-off (lock-hold time vs. failing large-store commits) is decided and recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] If the bound changes: local index operations in `event_commit_git` use a bound sized for local work, the c2ba pin test is updated to assert the new relationship, and a regression test covers it.
- [ ] If the bound stays: the reason is recorded here and in the `_GIT_TIMEOUT` comment in `event_commit_git.py`.
compiled_state.title: Store event writes bound git add/commit at the 30 s push bound; a commit on a large or stat-dirty tracker times out and the write is lost
